home.step1.title: Post your ride
home.step1.desc: Describe what you need to transport, upload photos and set your suggested price.

home.step2.desc: Drivers contact you and can negotiate the price in the chat.

home.step4.desc: Verify the delivery photo and pay securely with Stripe.
home.features.title: Features
home.features.multipleImages.desc: Upload up to 8 photos of your cargo for better quotes.
home.features.realtimeTracking.desc: Know exactly where your cargo is at all times.
home.features.directChat.desc: Communicate with the driver without intermediaries.
home.features.ratings.desc: Each user has a verified rating for greater trust.

home.forClients.heading: Your cargo in good hands
home.forClients.desc: Find reliable drivers for any type of haul. From complete moves to product deliveries.

home.forDrivers.title: For Drivers
home.forDrivers.heading: Generate income with your vehicle
home.forDrivers.desc: Accept rides near your location, negotiate prices and generate extra income. Your schedule, your vehicle, your rules.
home.forDrivers.benefit2: Filters by distance and cargo type
home.cta.title: Ready for your first haul?
home.cta.desc: Start today. It's fast, secure and with no commitments.
